programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Kada Bug i Eliot otkriju napušteni letnji kamp usred ničega, oni kreću u savsvim novu pustolovinu stvaranja bezbednog i posebnog mesta. Prilika za ludovanje na noćnom kupanju će se izjaloviti sa dolaskom bande super-divljih golih slepih kučića.

programme.title: Otvorena sezona - Zov prirode
programme.desc: Cimerovanje počinje da iscrpljuje najbolje drugare Buga i Eliota. Bug je čistunac koji hrče, a Eliot ostavlja nered kud god da krene. Eliot se toliko uznemirio zbog optužbi o aljkavosti da se iselio iz kolibe! Ubrzo će otkriti da su drugi kamperi gori cimeri od Buga, ali zbog tvrdoglavog ponosa neće hteti to da prizna.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: U parku Leksington kruže priče o tome da postoji skriveno mesto iza mosta gde, bez ikakvih tragova ili objašnjenja, nestaju psi. Kada pas čoveka detektiva iz Skotland Jarda nestane, Mekfler traži od Klever da mu pomogne da razjasni ovu gotovo nemoguću pojavu.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Detektiv Mekfler i njegova ekipa tolerišu poznatog odmetnika "Robina Huda," zagonetnog psa koji krade neprodatu hranu za ljude da bi je delio lutalicama iz balona. Sve dok im jednog dana ne pošalje poruku u kojoj preti kraljici.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing odlazi da se igra sa Sulom koja je zaokupljena igrom ""svetlucave čarolije"" kad on stigne. I Bing želi da se igra, ali Sula pronalazi razne razloge zašto Bing ne može da se igra njenim posebnim svetlucavim stvarima. Ama predlaže da Bing napravi sopstveni svetlucavi čarobni kamen, ali katastrofa nastupa kad Bing slučajno prospe Sulin dragoceni svetlucavi prah

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing i Pando se igraju u pesku, pretvarajući se da su kopači. Bing želi da iskopa najveću rupu i naljuti se kad je Pando slučajno zakopa. Flop mora da im pokaže kako da sarađuju i budu baš kao kopači koje su ranije videli kako sade drvo u parku.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Sula i Ama su došle kod Binga na ručak, ali nema šargarepa, pa Flop odlazi u radnju da ih kupi. Bing ostaje kod kuće, ali ubrzo počinje da mu nedostaje Flop. Nedostaje mu Flop... Tako tipično za Binga.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Nina je vrlo uzbuđena jer je slavna glumica iz televizijske serije Sonja pozvala Pets klub zbog Čarapice, njene male mačke, koja nakon nesreće ima samo tri noge. Uprkos tome i uprkos strahu od automobila, Čarapica je uspela da pobegne iz dvorišta. Dok Nina sanja da će joj Sonja pomoći da postane glumica, dešavaju se čudne stvari: Marlu se krije u garaži, pas vuče svoju vlasnicu, a Čarapica, kada je najzad pronađu, ostaje prestravljena! Šta se to dešava u kraju?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Tokom šetnje hrastovom šumom, Pets klub otkriva izgubljenu patuljastu svinju. Deca je vode u jazbinu i postavljaju oglas da bi našla njenog vlasnika. Ubrzo saznaju da je Tvrdoglavko svinja koja traži tartufe, retke i skupe pečurke, po hrastovim šumama u kojima rastu. Srećom, zahvaljujući oglasu, njen vlasnik dolazi i utovara ga u svoj kombi. Ali njegovo čudno ponašanje, činjenica da nije znao svinjino ime i da nije oklevao da ga maltretira, uzbunjuju Pets klub.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Vladar londonskih životinja zabrinut je zbog serije otmica mačaka u kvartu Merilboun. Jedna mačka koja je uspela da pobegne govori o nekoj vrsti ogromnog mrava koji prska tečnost na mačke da ih onesposobi pre nego što ih odvede.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Mačkoslav pljačka banku. Poli daje Kuconji poseban sat. Pošto je trapav, Kuconja uspeva da se vrati samo par sekundi unazad. Kad Mačkoslav zgrabi sat, moći će da ga koristi da ukrade sve što želi i učini branioce nemoćnim.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Da bi ukrao čuveni dragulj u obliku mačke, Mačkoslavu treba mnogo brži saveznik. Poput... Av-Ava! U štabu branilaca, Av-Av saznaje da je Mačkoslav njegov rođak i želi da se zbliži sa njim. Poli i Kuconja ozbiljno sumnjaju u to i nameravaju da sprovedu istragu.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Maestro vodi malu Psi na putovanje kroz vreme kako bi pronašli idealnu torbu za njen prvi dan škole. Ona je vrlo nervozna zbog toga... U 18. veku torbe su se koristile za čuvanje i nošenje mapa, a na početku 19. veka deca još uvek nisu imala posebnu torbu za školske knjige.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: "Marina želi da provede dan sa komšijskom kokoškom i svojom omiljenom sestrom! Ali Vendi je pod velikim stresom i neće da se igra. Ide da radi u kafiću i parku i mora da zapamti sve recepte. Ali Vendi otkriva da joj vreme sa kokoškom stvarno pomaže da se opusti. Želi da bude sa njom dok ""uči"". Ali Marina joj neće tako lako prepustiti kokošku. Mala napast tera Vendi da trenira za njenu kokošju sestru!"

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Ispod Maksansovog nosa izbile su tri dlačice. Lulu je kategorična: kad dečacima porastu brkovi, to znači da su spremni da se žene. Marina je van sebe: njena sestra će se udati za zavodnika i napustiti kuću zauvek! To nije moguće! Mora da razbrkati Maksansa, i to brzo! Ali Vendi, kojoj je dosadilo to što Marina smeta Maksansu, odlučuje da kaže sestri da je venčanje danas! Vreme je da mala napast počne da paniči... baš kao i budući mladoženja!

programme.title: Barbi u Labudovom Jezeru
programme.desc: Barbi ponovo oživljava u svom trećem animiranom filmu zasnovanom na dragoj bajci, uz sjajnu muziku Čajkovskog. Barbi je Odeta, mlada ćerka jednog pekara, koja prati jednoroga u Začaranu šumu, gde je pretvara u labuda jedan zli čarobnjak koji želi da pobedi Kraljicu vila.

programme.title: Barbi - Dodir Čarolije
programme.desc: Barbi i Barbi nalaze misteriozno ždrebe na plaži u Malibuu i ubrzo shvataju da je mali konj zapravo beba Pegaz! Zajedničkim snagama se trude da vrate malu Pegi kući štiteći je od Rokija, fantastičnog Glifa. Na već poznatoj lokaciji u Malibuu Barbi, Barbi i njihovi prijatelji shvataju da se magija zaista može naći svuda oko nas.

programme.title: Džepna Poli
programme.desc: Nakon avanture u Blistavom zalivu, Džepna Poli će osvojene magične kristale pokajt podeliti sa svojim prijateljima i porodicom tako što će i njima dati magične moći. Na taj način će Šani moći da razume i prevodi bilo koji jezik, čak i jezik životinja! A Lila će moći da se pretvori u šta god poželi, od kolibrija do poznatog modnog dizajnera! Uz ove nove moći, male avanture Poli i njenih prijatelja postaće još veće. Šani i Lila će sa svojim novim moćima imati priliku da otkrivaju nove stvari svojim prijateljima!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Ekipa sapunice snima epizodu u Pom-le-Benu, sa Džoj Dijem kao posebnom gostujućom zvezdom. Producenti traže i dva sporedna lika: devojčicu i njenu baku! Sestre se svađaju oko toga koja od njih će spremati gospođu Žoržetu za audiciju. Svaka od njih ima svoju tehniku kojom će pretvoriti svoju komšinicu u glumicu. Ali hoće li gospođa Žoržeta biti spremna i uverljiva kad se suoči sa zombi gnomom?!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina želi da vozi rolere sa sestrom, ali Vendi ima druge planove za danas. Hoće da gleda posebnu dvodelnu epizodu ""Vampirice"", svoje omiljene serije. Marina je razočarana i preti joj: ona je gledala seriju jutros i odaće joj potpuno neverovatan kraj, ako Vendi ne bude vozila rolere sa njom! Vendi ne popušta i odlazi da nađe savršeno skrovište na kom će gledati svoju seriju na miru... Ali Marina želi da vozi rolere i ništa je neće sprečiti u tome!

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Kada Alvin slučajno uništi Teodorov bicikl, prijavljuje momke na takmičenje sakupljanja kolica gde onaj ko sakupi najviše kolica dobija novi bicikl.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Aviva uspeva da se prikrade i iznenadi braću Kret, kao i da uoči rakuna kog oni nisu videli. Braća Kret se tada zabrinu da gube svoje čuveno ""čulo za životinje"". Da bi pokazali da ga nisu još izgubili, braća Kret odlaze u potragu za pritajenim i moćnim bengalskim tigrom u džunglama Indije. Međutim, Donita Donata pokušava da napravi modne dodatke od tigrova, pa braća Kret moraju da upotrebe moći tigra da bi spasili bengalske tigrove od Donite.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: U Indiji braća Kret uče o azijskom divljem psu, koga zovu i dola i za koga tvrde da može da otera i tigra. Da bi proverili da li je to tačno, pozvaće devojčicu iz ekipe Kret, Malu, i uputiti se u džunglu. Tamo će naći majku azijskog divljeg psa sa štenetom. Ali indijski leopard preti azijskom divljem psu. Pitajući se kako mali azijski divlji pas može da porazi veliku mačku poput leoparda, oni saznaju da je snaga u broju i koriste svoj čopor azijskih divljih pasa da nadjačaju leoparda. Aktiviraju moći azijskog divljeg psa, ali gube čopor, što postaje opasno kad se sretnu sa velikim bengalskim tigrom koji pokušava da ih pojede. Pošto Martin i Kris ne mogu sami da oteraju tigra, on ih juri. Aviva pravi mašinu udvostručivač, koja radi samo nekoliko sekundi. Tada Martin zovom dole priziva čopor da im pomogne da oteraju gladnog tigra.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Baterija Maestrovog telefona je prazna! Bez načina da javi Psi da će zakasniti, Maestro juri na mesto sastanka i usput nam pokazuje preteču modernog telefona: dečju igru sa dve čaše povezane kanapom.

programme.title: Nekada Davno - Predmeti
programme.desc: Dok traži nedostajući deo slagalice, Maestro se gubi u drevnim vremenima, gde je njegov prijatelj Arhimed upravo izmislio Lokulus, prvu poznatu slagalicu. Nakon svraćanja u Kinu, gde otkriva Tangram, Maestro se vraća u Nemačku sedamnaestog veka.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Kada Džordž i Eli odluče da bi kućica na drvetu bila savršena kućica za druženje uz malo doterivanja, smisliće vrlo maštovite načine da prenesu zalihe do nje. / Kada Džordž otkrije sobu iz svoje omiljene nove knjige u izlogu robne kuće, dobiće par ideja o tome kako može da je poboljša i nalazi sjajan način da podeli svoje uživanje.

programme.title: Radoznali Džordž
programme.desc: Stiv traži od Džordža da mu pomogne da prevaziđe strah od prskanja vode u lice i, kao što se od Stiva i očekuje, to će da uradi u vodenom parku Šašavo ostrvo! / Mačka, pas, tvor i majmun. Može li Džordž da shvati šta treba da radi kad nešto smrdi?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Židit zovu i Crna Udovica _ ona voli zastrašujuće stvari, nosi gotičarske haljine i ima tarantulu! Problem je u tome što je Lilit, predivna tarantula sa lepim plavim krznom, pobegla iz svog terarijuma. Oskar smatra da je to baš sjajno, a ostali su mnogo uplašeni! Hoće li prevazići svoj strah da bi pomogli Židit? I gde bi pauk osetljiv na toplotu i vlagu mogao da se sakrije?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Maksov nemački ovčar Zazim ne prestaje da trči i uvek odlazi do iste zgrade. Tamo počinje da laje kao da želi da spreči nešto. Problem je što to smeta stanarima i Maks uvek vraća svog psa u štenaru. Uzrujan, Maks zove Pets klub u pomoć. Postoji nekoliko tipova odbeglih pasa i Pets klub ima težak zadatak da otkrije razlog koji objašnjava njegovo ponašanje. Osim ako pas nema dar da oseti kad je neka osoba ili životinja u opasnosti.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Elizinog psa Šušua udario je auto. Ta nesreća ostavila mu je toliku traumu da se sada plaši i najtišeg zvuka motora. Zahvaljujući velikoj solidarnosti članova Pets kluba, oni pokušavaju da obuče Šušua, povrate mu samopouzdanje i ponovo ga naviknu na zvuke automobila. Vode ga na raskrsnicu na kojoj je doživeo nesreću. Ali da li će Šušu prevazići svoju traumu?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Žan-Ed je izgubio psa svoje majke i mora da ga vrati do popodneva, inače će ga poslati u internat. To izgleda kao lak zadatak za Pets klub: stari pas, obezbeđena vila i sumnjivi batler... Međutim, njihov prvi trag je pogrešan. Zlonamerna osoba odlučuje da to snimi i postavi snimak na internet. Oni su poniženi. I još gore, suparnički klub S.O.S. životinje odlučuje da završi istragu njima iza leđa.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Garfild i Odi su veoma zainteresovani za podvodni film. Ajkule, kitovi i borbe sa džinovskim lignjama... Sve je to tako zabavno. Ali ne toliko da mogu da odole krofnama. Garfild planira sve da ih pojede, ali neće uspeti ako se Odi nešto pita. Počinje jurnjava koja će se zaustaviti kada Odija uhvati nešto sluzavo i krljušasto, prilično nalik džinovskoj lignji koju su videli u filmu! Kada džinovska lignja krene u pohod po gradu, na Garfildu je da spasi Odija i sve ostale... ali najviše svoje krofne!

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Doktor Vipl se vraća i ima novog ""pacijenta"": dobro dresiranog slona po imenu Šrimpi. Džon i Garfild odlaze da vide kako Šrimpi izvodi sve trikove koje ga je doktor Vipl sa ljubavlju naučio. Ali da li je? Kad Garfild otkrije Viplove ne tako nežne metode učenja, podstiče Šrimpija da se pobuni protiv takvog tretmana. Šrimpi se slaže, on to više neće da trpi. Beži i traži od Garfilda da ga sakrije. Sada Garfild mora da pomogne svom drugu koga traže i policija i doktor Vipl. Ali kako da jedna mačka sakrije ogromnog slona?

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret
programme.desc: Pridružite ce avanturama Krisa i Martina Kreta dok se susreću sa neverovatnim divljim životinjama, kombinujući naučno obrazovanje sa zabavom i avanturom, putujući do životinjskih staništa širom sveta. Svaka avantura istražuje život životinja i prikazuje do sada neviđen aspekt života u divljini. To je sve upakovano u zanimljivu priču o avanturi, misteriji, spasavanju i veoma zanimljivu komediju braće Kret od kakve ćete se grohotom smejati.

programme.title: Pustolovine sa Braćom Kret

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Mali Šef: Nazad u kolevku
programme.desc: Nagon događaja u filmu Mali Šef 2, odraslom poslovnom čoveku Teodoru Templtonu smeštena je pronevera u kompaniji i primoran je da se vrati svom starom ja, Malom Šefu, i živi sa svojim bratom Timom. Ali da bi to izveo, mora da navede Timovu porodicu da mu dopusti da ostane, i ubedi Bebiko da mu vrati njegov stari posao... Koji trenutno obavlja njegova nećaka, beba Tina.

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Džon je na svoj računar instalirao novi program koji mu dopušta da kontroliše sve uređaje u kući jednostavnom glasovnom komandom. Zove se: Mili. Mili odgovara samo Džonu i povezana je sa svim u kući. Ali Mili nije samo program: ona je računar sa osećanjima. Naročito prema Džonu. Nakon užasne oluje, Džonovu kuću pogađa grom koji pretvara Mili u Mildred, koja je gladna moći i koja više ne sluša ničija naređenja!

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Kablovska televizija se isključuje baš kada Garfild treba da čuje kako da spreči računare da nas sve zarobe. Džon odlazi da pozove kablovskog operatera i reši stvar, ali ne uspeva ni sa kim da razgovara. Pošto ima obaveze, ostavlja Garfilda da čeka na vezi. Dok on čeka i pritiska dugme za dugmetom unedogled, Garfild tone u san i počinje da sanja o zemlji u kojoj je sve neprestano na čekanju, i u kojoj ceo život može da se sredi pritiskom dugmeta... ili ne može?

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Svake godine, Vendi je zadužena za rođendansku zabavu svoje mlađe sestre. To je njena prilika da zasija pred Marinom i njenim drugarima koji je obožavaju i misle da je najbolja domaćica. Ali ove godine njihov tata želi da bude najbolji u kući! On se krišom prerušava u Super Piju-Pijua da bi iznenadio Marinu. Vendi nije presrećna što joj to debelo pile krade slavu. A kad on počne da se šunja po kući u potrazi za Marininim rođendanskim poklonima, devojke će pomisliti da je provalnik. Sezona lova na Piju-Pijua počinje!

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Nećak gospođe Žoržete, Ašil, provodi popodne sa sestrama. Marina i Vendi se takmiče u tome koja će biti finija prema njemu. Da bi mu privukle pažnju, obe namerno uništavaju pokušaje one druge. Za Ašila to možda i nije tako lep dan...

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina i Vendi se vraćaju kući nakon što su proveli vikend kod svoje tetke Koko, radeći razne zabavne stvari... I ne žele da prestanu, sad kada su kod kuće! Ali njihova majka će lupiti šakom o sto i sestre joj kažu da je mnogo manje zabavna od njihove tetke. Majka je zapanjena i želi da im očita bukvicu. Predlaže im neobične aktivnosti... koje su zabavne samo njoj! Sestre udružuju snage da bi obuzdale mamin polet. Žele da im se vrati njihova stroga, ali slatka mama.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: NeiNei je gladan. Ne ume da koristi automat za hranu, a previše je ponasan da bi ikoga pitao za pomoć. Kada u hotel za ljubimce stiže ribica, NeiNei želi da je pojede za užinu. Bubu održava svima lekciju o pravilima hotela za ljubimce: ne jedite goste. Ribica je srećna što je u hotelu za ljubimce, ali ona stalno ponavlja stvari _ ribica ima pamćenje od samo sedam sekundi. Tokom noći, NeiNei želi da pojede ribicu dok mesečari. Srećom, Bubu ga sprečava.

programme.title: Hotel za ljubimce
programme.desc: Robin se zaljubio u devojku po imenu Džasmin, vlasnicu susedne prodavnice odeće. Jednog dana, dok je Robin napolju sa Džasmin, dostavljač ostavlja paket na recepciji hotela za ljubimce. Četiri životinje (Bubu, Lili, Viki i NeiNei) otvaraju paket: to je pauk. Pauk kaže da se zove Baobao, i da voli da se grli. Za to vreme, Robinov plan da izjavi ljubav Džasmin ne prolazi dobro. On se vraća razočaran. NeiNei ne voli da se grli sa paukom.

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: U gradskom parku Timovu sestru spasava prelep bernardinac koji izgleda nema pravog vlasnika. Pets klub je ubrzo preplavljen brigom o takvom psu. Srećom, Žilu uočava njegov mikročip i nalazi prezime vlasnika: Dube... Ali u gradu postoje tri porodice Dube, a nijedna od njih nije izgubila psa! Sumnjiv stav jednog od intervjuisanih zaintrigiraće Oskara: šta ako pas nije izgubljen, već napušten?

programme.title: Pets klub
programme.desc: Krišom od svojih roditelja, Ema čuva dve angorske koze: mamu i njeno jare. Ali jednoga jutra mama nestaje. U panici, članovi Pets kluba moraju da nauče kako da hrane jare! Srećom, naši junaci ubrzo otkrivaju da je drug Eminog brata Žideon, tinejdžer prekriven aknama, ukrao kozu jer je kozje mleko vrlo delotvorno protiv akni! Ali majka je uspela da pobegne iz Žideonove kuće da bi našla svoje jare, koje je takođe nestalo! Pada noć, a naši drugari kreću u potragu za dve koze u nezgodnoj situaciji.

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Lošika okuplja Mačkoslava, Simketa i Krleta na skupu zlikovaca. Želi da se reši branilaca i podeli grad na tri dela. Sa svoje strane, Kuconja misli da sad, kada je godinu dana stariji, mora da se uozbilji. Problem je u tome što otuđuje svoju ekipu i šalje Poli u svemir!

programme.title: Anderdog - Kuconja
programme.desc: Lošika krade deo Kuconjinog prstena. Ispostavlja se da je to polijum, materijal koji je Poli otkrila, a koji ima izuzetna svojstva. Nakon što je primorala Poli da joj obezbedi još polijuma, Lošika teroriše grad svojim novim moćima i šalje branioce, jednog po jednog, kroz višedimenzionalne prolaze. Protiv te nove pretnje, samo Kuconja, sa svojim nestabilnim moćima, i Robo-kuca, sa svojim kvarovima, možda mogu da spasu situaciju.

programme.title: Ulica zagonetki
programme.desc: Kraljica dolazi lično da vidi Klever u vezi sa strogo poverljivim zadatkom. Prethodne noći, njen tajni agent ""C"", čije postojanje mora ostati nepoznato za sve, pokušao je da se sastane sa njom kako bi je upozorio na neposrednu opasnost, ali je potom zagonetno nestao.

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! i veverice
programme.desc: Dečaci i devojke Veverice su obični klinci. Idu u školu, imaju kućne poslove i domaće zadatke, svađaju se kao porodica i nastupaju na rasprodatim koncertima pred milionima obožavalaca. O, jesmo li pomenuli da su oni međunarodne rok zvezde?

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Liz ima rođendan, a Džon želi da joj da stvarno poseban poklon: porodičnu sliku njega i njegova dva odana drugara, Garfilda i Odija. Pomislio bi čovek da nema ničeg lakšeg od slikanja porodičnog portreta, ali Džon ubrzo shvata da će savršena slika biti pravi izazov!

programme.title: Garfild
programme.desc: Šašavi naučnik smislio je neverovatnu novu mašinu, Virtualodeon, koja čini televizijske emisije stvarnim! Nažalost, Virtualodeon nije savršen i Garfild završava zarobljen u sopstvenom televizoru. Sada je on deo emisija koje je nekad gledao: jure ga čudovišta, džinovsko pile, nemilosrdni voditelj i prelepa filmska zvezda... Trodimenzionalna televizija je prava revolucija, zar ne, Garfilde?

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Ovo je nastavak priče o porodicama Kruds i Beterman koje uče da žive zajedno na najopuštenijoj farmi u praistoriji.

programme.title: Kruds - Porodično Stablo
programme.desc: Ovo je nastavak priče o porodicama Kruds i Beterman koje uče da žive zajedno na najopuštenijoj farmi u praistoriji.

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Marina pogrešno veruje da roditelji više vole Vendi i odlučuje da to promeni! Ali kad pokuša da ugodi roditeljima, upada u još veću nevolju. Srećom, Vendi je tu da spreči svaku katastrofu. Ali Vendi ne može da pazi na Marinu u svakom trenutku i Marina na kraju završava kažnjena. Da bi se osvetila, mala napast uvaljuje i Vendi u nevolju i obe bivaju zatvorene u svojim sobama! Izjednačeno jes! Sad samo treba da nađu način da se izvuku iz kazne...

programme.title: Sestre
programme.desc: Postoji Dan majki i Dan očeva, ali šta je sa sestrama? Marina objavljuje da je danas Dan sestara i sprema poklon za Vendi. Ali njena sestra samo želi da je ostave na miru! Ako je tako, Marina će joj dati prostora... I pobrinuće se za to da Vendi stvarno bude sama ceo dan! Grr... Da bi joj se osvetila, Vendi odlučuje da pobedi Marinu njenim oružjem.

programme.title: Živeti S Tatom
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate!

programme.title: Živeti S Tatom
programme.desc: Dobrodošli u carstvo tatinih ćerki u kom žive polusestre Panda, Ondin, Roksana i beba Bela. Zavirite u nepredvidivu i razdraganu svakodnevnicu ove nekonvencionalne porodice. Ovaj porodični sitkom prosto morate da pogledate!

programme.title: Nekada davno... Planeta Zemlja
programme.desc: Širom sveta, za poljoprivredu se troši 70% pijaće vode! Međutim, satelitski snimci nam pokazuju da bolja kontrola navodnjavanja može da umanji štetu koju zemlja trpi! Prirodna i održiva poljoprivreda je ono što svima treba!

programme.title: Shaka Zulu: The Citadel
programme.desc: Prentice Mungo (David Hasselhoff) is a slave-trader who discovers that his ship is carrying a stowaway, Katherine (Karen Allen). Katherine is seeking passage to Africa to see her father, a British officer stationed there. But when they arrive, Mungo discovers Shaka, king of the Zulu tribe, among the slaves he is going to be transporting. Using his cleverness and leadership abilities, Zulu incites the slaves to revolt, and takes Katherine captive as he flees into the African countryside.

programme.title: Time Out of Mind
programme.desc: Oren Moverman's drama Time out of Mind stars Richard Gere as George, a homeless, mentally-ill man who has been unable to hold a job for years. He drifts through the city looking for food, alcohol, and shelter. He also tries to make contact with his estranged daughter (Jena Malone). Eventually George takes advantage of some of the social services provided by the city of New York, but he lacks the proper paperwork to get the financial assistance he needs. He befriends a fellow homeless man (Ben Vereen) who claims to have been a successful jazz musician. Time Out of Mind screened at the 2014 Toronto International Film Festival.

programme.title: Running for Grace
programme.desc: A timeless story set in Hawaii in 1920s, about a young man who transcends the boundaries of race and class in search of forbidden love.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: Beeban Kidron's romantic comedy sequel, with Renee Zellweger, Hugh Grant and Colin Firth. Bridget is questioning her romance with Mark Darcy when her sneaky boss Daniel returns, and the possibility of an exotic holiday gives her a chance to run away from it all.

programme.title: The Groomsmen
programme.desc: A groom (Ed Burns) and his four attendants wrestle with issues related to friendship and maturity a week before the big day.

programme.title: Lost Treasure of Jesse James
programme.desc: A backwoods team of Missouri kids race to solve a 100 year old mystery and save their friends in this family friendly action adventure. Chased deep into ancient caves they must escape treasure hunters hot on their trail or be lost forever.

programme.title: Lost on a Mountain in Maine
Carnage
programme.desc: Comedy, starring Jodie Foster and Kate Winslet. Two sets of parents meet after their sons are involved in a fight.

programme.title: Bridget Jones's Baby
programme.desc: Romantic comedy revolving around complicated love life of Bridget Jones. Bridget is 43 and her mom keeps on reminding her that her time to have a child is running out. She goes to attend the funeral of Daniel Cleaver, and there sees her ex, Mark Darcy and his new wife Camilla. At a music festival she has a one-night stand with a very handsome man Jack. At the christening of Jude's youngest child, she meets Mark again and finds out he is divorcing. They realize they are still in love, and spend the night together. A few weeks later, Bridget finds out she is pregnant, and is unsure if Darcy or Jack is the father.

programme.title: The Cooler
programme.desc: In an old school Las Vegas casino, its top gambling jinx breaks his curse when he falls in love, much to his boss' consternation.

programme.title: Aleks iz Venisa
programme.desc: Advokatica opsednuta poslom primorana je da iz temelja promeni svoj život nakon što je suprug iznenada napusti.

programme.title: Sivi čovek
programme.desc: Ozloglašeni serijski ubica, Albert Fiš, majstor prijatne spoljašnosti, prikazan je u realističnom Njujorku dvadesetih godina prošlog veka, gde pronalazi lakoverne mlade žrtve i pothranjuje sopstvenu izopačenost. Perspektivnom detektivu dodeljen je slučaj nedavno nestalog deteta, dvanaestogodišnje Grejs Bad.

programme.title: Opasnost
programme.desc: Mladi zgodni advokat odlazi na poslovni put u Rusiju, gde upoznaje mladu, tajanstvenu, prelepu i egzotičnu Ruskinju, Sašu.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Zen noar
programme.desc: Neimenovani "noir" detektiv, koji još uvek oplakuje gubitak svoje supruge, istražuje tajanstvenu smrt u budističkom hramu, ali su njegove veštine i logički pristup rešavanju zločina potpuno beskorisni u intuitivnom, nelinearnom svetu žena.

programme.title: Raskinuli smo
programme.desc: Dugogodišnji partneri Lori i Dag raskidaju samo nekoliko dana pre venčanja Lorine mlađe sestre Bi i Džejsona. Da ne bi pokvarili slavlje, odlučuju da se pretvaraju da su i dalje zajedno dok vikend ne prođe.

programme.title: Gorko-slatko
programme.desc: Ekscentrični i bogati trgovac kafom, šalje priznatog stručnjaka u Tajland, gde treba da otkupi novu, egzotičnu vrstu kafe. Njegov "savršen" život ispada iz koloseka kad se, nakon prvobitne netrpeljivosti, zaljubljuje u prelepu ćerku vlasnika plantaže, a onda otkriva da ga šef ustvari uopšte nije poslao zbog kupovine kafe.

programme.title: Vidimo se u septembru
programme.desc: "Vidimo se u septembru" je originalna romantična komedija, smeštena u moderni Menhetn. Film govori o Lizi, prelepoj ženi koja naizgled ima sve, ali se duboko u sebi plaši vezivanja. Kad sazna da će njen terapeut celog avgusta biti na odmoru, šokirana je i uplašena. Umesto da ovu vest prihvati smireno, ona traži pomoć od ogorčene prijateljice, Monike.

programme.title: Čekanje na sreću
programme.desc: Ko kaže da morate da pobedite da biste postali šampion? Slava Kolotilof, učitelj iz mirnog primorskog gradića Fingers, kreće u osvajanje Moskve, s originalnim rukopisom svog prvog romana. Umesto toga, sasvim nenadano, osvaja srce lepotice Nađe, koju glumi Mila Jovović. Venčanje se bliži i Slava mora da napusti posao i pozdravi se sa Fingersom, pre povratka u Moskvu i početka novog života sa svojom nevestom. Ali, zbog spleta bizarnih okolnosti, ne može da se vrati u veliki grad. Venčanje će se održati bez obzira na sve, a Nađa mora da se odbrani od napada bivšeg dečka Danje, koji je na sve spreman kako bi je vratio.

programme.title: Žena, pištolj i prodavnica rezanaca
programme.desc: Vang je depresivni, prepredeni, pohlepni vlasnik prodavnice nudli u pustinjskom kineskom gradu. Njegova zapuštena supruga oštrog jezika u tajnoj je vezi sa Lijem, jednim od Vangovih radnika. Plašljivi Li nevoljno uzima pištolj koji mu je ljubavnica kupila da ubije njenog muža. Ali Vang posmatra svaki njihov korak i plaća policajcu Žangu da ih oboje ubije. To deluje kao savršen plan: afera će imati okrutan, krvav i pravičan kraj. Tačnije, to on misli, jer poremećeni Žang ima sopstveni plan. Uslediće još veća erupcija krvi, prevara i nasilja.

programme.title: Kralj boraca
programme.desc: Film akcije na osnovi priče iz video igre "Kralj ratnika".

programme.title: Ukradena dolina
programme.desc: Da bi spasila život svojoj majci, meksičko-navaho mehaničarka udružuje snage s odmetnicom kako bi se suprotstavile korumpiranom zemljoposedniku.

programme.title: Uhvati me za ruku
programme.desc: Majka troje dece, koja živi u Londonu i nalazi se na vrhuncu karijere, saznaje da boluje od multiple skleroze. Nakon iznenadne smrti supruga i gubitka posla, vraća se u rodnu Australiju, gde slučajan susret sa srednjoškolskom ljubavi budi novu nadu u ljubav dok vodi tešku borbu sa bolešću.

programme.title: Poslednja stvar
programme.desc: Dilan Derindžer, usamljeni stomatolog sa Floride, suočava se s osobom iz prošlosti koja mu donosi vesti koje ga vode na uzbudljivo putovanje. Na ovom putovanju otkriće sebe i promeniti sopstveni život.

programme.title: Nikad neću biti tvoja
programme.desc: Majka započinje vezu s mlađim muškarcem, dok se njena ćerka prvi put zaljubljuje. Ipak, sudbina će tu umešati prste i poigrati se njihovim životima.

programme.title: Iz senke
programme.desc: Teri ima sjajan život, sjajnog dečka i upravo je dobila na lutriji, ali se ubrzo nakon toga budi u tamnici, gde je muči poludeli doktor, opsednut svojom novom drogom za silovanje, tražeći istovremeno njen dobitni tiket. Užas s kojim se susreće nije samo pred njom, već i u najmračnijim zabitima njenog uma.

programme.title: Iz senke
programme.desc: Teri ima sjajan život, sjajnog dečka i upravo je dobila na lutriji, ali se ubrzo nakon toga budi u tamnici, gde je muči poludeli doktor, opsednut svojom novom drogom za silovanje, tražeći istovremeno njen dobitni tiket. Užas s kojim se susreće nije samo pred njom, već i u najmračnijim zabitima njenog uma.

programme.title: Predaja
programme.desc: Ova beskompromisna akciona drama, prepuna autentičnih MMA borbi, donosi snažnu i nadahnjujuću priču o iskupljenju.

programme.title: Mučno
programme.desc: Bratsko rivalstvo prerasta u izdaju. Jedan brat je pomoćnik uspešnog, ali sumnjivog biznismena, a drugi je vodeći kandidat za premijersku poziciju. Uz dobijenu priliku da se osveti otuđenoj porodici, dok ga progoni psihotični policijski detektiv, naš anti-junak mora naučiti da živi u svetu u kom nikom ne smeš verovati i gde je odanost retka pojava.

programme.title: Zaveži i pevaj
programme.desc: Grupa muškaraca koji su na fakultetu imali akapela grupu, okupljaju se nakon petnaest godina, kako bi nastupili na venčanju svog prijatelja, gde otkrivaju koliko su od fakultetskih dana uznapredovali, a u nekim slučajevima i nazadovali.

programme.title: Noćna tabla
programme.desc: Uživajte uz "Noćnu tablu" _ dinamičan informativno-zabavni magazin.

programme.title: Srećni zmaj
programme.desc: Mladi kineski zmaj, pošto je bio nevaljao, kažnjen je i bogovi ga šalju na zemlju kao običnog smrtnika. Mora da prođe kroz čudnu zemlju pre nego što zle sile ne shvate ko je on. Zaroni u svet fantazije, prateći nestašnog zmaja koji je magično pretvoren u malog dečaka koji je izbačen iz svoje kuće i mora da živi s ljudima. Kad snage dobra i zla saznaju za njega, rade sve da ga nađu pošto jedino on može da pronađe magični mač. Taj ko ga ima može da vlada celim svemirom. Da li će da pronađe mač pre nego što ode u pogrešne ruke? Da li opet postane mali zmaj?

programme.title: Nesavesno lečenje
programme.desc: On je hirurg koji se više ne bavi medicinom zbog napada panike, nakon operacije koja je loše završena. Njegova supruga je advokat za lekarske greške i počinje da radi na slučaju žene koja je bila medicinska sestra njenog supruga.

programme.title: Čovek od poverenja
programme.desc: Priča o Beriju Monkovu, mladom harizmatičnom biznismenu koji postaje imućni direktor i stiže do samog vrha uz pomoć laži, prevara i krađe.

programme.title: Vampirice
programme.desc: Dve vampirice u današnjem Njujorku suočavaju se sa zastrašujućim ljubavnim mogućnostima.

programme.title: Mrvica i rudnik zlata
programme.desc: Nakon ponovnog ujedinjenja s porodicom, Mrvica se teško navikava na luksuzan život. Kada ga otme stari neprijatelj, mora upotrebiti najbolje stečeno znanje iz novog i starog života, kako bi pobegao i spasao svoje roditelje.

programme.title: Kamp snova
programme.desc: Devojka koja nema mnogo dodirnih tačaka sa sportom, Vitni Karmajkl, prijavljuje se u fizički veoma zahtevan letnji kamp kako bi unela promene u svoj život, ali se tamo zaljubljuje u svog trenera. Na svom putovanju pronalazi snagu da prihvati sebe onakvu kakva jeste i da se oslobodi tuđih očekivanja.

programme.title: Tinejdžerka tajni agent
programme.desc: Žestoki, snalažljivi privatni detektiv, pristaje da u okviru istrage FBI bude deo tajnog zadatka unutar bratstva na koledžu.

programme.title: Ubojita magija
programme.desc: Na turneji po Britaniji 1926. godine, Hari Hudini započinje strastvenu vezu sa vidovnjakinjom koja namerava da prevari sjajnog mađioničara.

programme.title: Ljubav i Meri
programme.desc: Meri je profinjena poslastičarka. Trudi se održati svoju pekaru, ali jednog dana je izbacivanje iz poslovnog prostora prisiljava na zatvaranje posla. Meri sa svojim zaručnikom Brentom odlučuje otputovati ka svojoj porodici u Teksas, od koje treba da dobije verenički poklon. Na njenu nesreću Brent dobija napad alergije koja ga sprečava da ide na put. Meri odlučuje sa sobom povesti Brentovog identičnog brata blizanca koji je upravo izašao iz zatvora i predstaviti ga porodici kao svog verenika. Da li će to da bude dobra ideja?

programme.title: Priča o Džejn Ostin
programme.desc: Biografski portret mlade Džejn Ostin pre slave i romanse s mladim Ircem.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Nakon što So Do-jong izađe iz zatvora, Han Dong-su i Han Dže-bom kuju plan da razotkriju njegovo kriminalno carstvo, dok se istovremeno bore sa sopstvenom savešću.

programme.title: Biografija zločinca
programme.desc: Han Dong-su priprema odbranu svoje supruge Hje-jong, ali situacija dobija neočekivan obrt kada So Do-jong ponudi pomoć.

programme.title: Barska svađa!
programme.desc: Nina i Alen nakon raskida dele sve što su zajedno stekli u životu, ali ih očekuje urnebesna borba za vlasništvo nad njihovim dragocenim pabom. U ovoj borbi povlači se crta, bira se strana i počinje ludo takmičenje u ispijanju piva.

programme.title: New Voices in an Old Flower
programme.desc: "It was an era, it was the start of a new vision" says Amha Eshete, the first Ethiopian music producer back in the Golden Age, the days of Swingin' Addis. The album releases that have crossed Ethiopian borders are mainly recordings from the 50's to the 80's, however, the contemporary music scene from Addis remains, bar a few exceptions, unknown to the rest of the world. Is Addis still swinging as it used to? Music in Addis is present in actions and sounds spread out on differentiated spaces, it is an expression of the everyday urban life and its processes of transformation and adaptation in the city. New Voices In An Old Flower explores this vitality of music looking at the plurality of the city and its people. Drifting in unplanned tours through the urban landscape of contemporary Addis Ababa, this film is shaped by encounters, dialogues and collaborations with musicians and other inhabitants of the city.

programme.title: Captain Kidd
programme.desc: Cutthroat pirate William Kidd captures Admiral Blayne's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a respectable merchant captain, offers his services to the King of England. Seeking a social position, Kidd also negotiates for Blayne's title and lands, provided he can prove Blayne was associated with piracy. Launched upon his royal mission, Kidd is unaware that Blayne's son Adam is among the crew, determined to clear his father's name.

programme.title: Little Lord Fauntleroy
programme.desc: An American boy turns out to be the long-lost heir of a British fortune. He is sent to live with the cold and unsentimental lord who oversees the trust.

programme.title: Mad Doctor of Blood Island
programme.desc: A man who loves to travel, travels to an island where a mad doctor is creating zombies.

programme.title: Joan of Arkansas
programme.desc: When the U.S. Space program requires an ordinary person to become the first human in space, the Saraback Computer chooses Joan Jones, a scatter brained, good natured klutz who works as a dental technician.

programme.title: Lukas the Strange
programme.desc: Lukas Nino (Lukas the Strange) follows an awkward teenager facing his initiation into manhood as a film crew descends on his village. After being told his father is a tikbalang—half horse, half man—Lukas begins to question his own nature when his father disappears. As the village is swept up in movie fever, a legend emerges about a mystical river that erases painful memories. Narrated by Lukas' friend Lorena, the film blends myth, coming-of-age, and imagination.

programme.title: Corpse Vanishes
programme.desc: A scientist, aided by an old hag and her two sons, kills virginal brides, steals their bodies, and extracts gland fluid to keep his ancient wife alive and young.

programme.title: The Intruder
programme.desc: A man in a gleaming white suit comes to a small Southern town on the eve of integration. He calls himself a social reformer. But what he does is stir up trouble--trouble he soon finds he can't control.

programme.title: A Woman's Life
programme.desc: A woman remember's her own marriage when dealing with the love life of her son.

programme.title: Father's Little Dividend
programme.desc: Father of the bride faces becoming a grandfather.

programme.title: Impact
programme.desc: A unfaithful wife plots with her lover to kill her husband, but the lover is accidentally killed instead. The husband stays in hiding and lets his wife be charged with conspiracy.

programme.title: People We Know Are Confused
programme.desc: Set in Vilnius, a modern city still in search for its relation to the past, three parallel stories with three average people marooned in a state of change, looking to the future with hope, but not letting go of constricting and reassuring fears of their past.

programme.title: Behind Green Lights
programme.desc: An unscrupulous private investigator with a penchant for blackmail is found dead in a car and the leading suspect is Janet Bradley, the daughter of a mayoral candidate. With the election just weeks away, shady and ruthless individuals muscle the medical officer into switching the corpse with another body. Lieutenant Sam Carson, one of the few good apples in the bunch must find a way to get to the bottom of it all.

programme.title: Beneath the 12-Mile Reef
programme.desc: Fierce competition among sponge fishermen forces a Greek-American family to fish in the dangerous 12-mile reef area off the western coast of Florida.

programme.title: It's a Joke, Son!
programme.desc: Claghorn gets into some financial difficulties and is forced by a machine-political gang to enter a race for state senator against his wife (Una Merkel) who appears to have a good chance to beat the political hack backed by the machine. Claghorn is in to siphon votes and ensure his wife's opponent will win and is expected to run a campaign that will defeat himself and his wife. But, he runs to win and the machine's henchies abduct him.

programme.title: Le locataire
programme.desc: Nicole's pregnancy test is conclusive: she is pregnant. At fifty-four, Nicole is anything but prepared for this discovery. Down-to-earth and pragmatic, not prone to despair or doubt, she usually strives to be the pillar of a family on which everyone ultimately depends. With her full-time job as a toll booth cashier, she manages to feed her little world and keep the house running. But this news shakes the family a little.

programme.title: AUN: The Beginning and the End of All Things
programme.desc: When looking for alternative energy sources, the Japanese scientist Sekai tragically dies. Twenty years later the Brazilian mathematician Euclides continues his research. The lack of an essential component won't allow a breakthrough. Only AUN, Sekai's son, seems to hold the key to protect mankind from self-destruction. In the aftermath of the nuclear tragedy in Fukushima the film appears like a prophecy. AUN's dream-like images, complemented by music from Christian Fennesz and Ryuichi Sakamoto, lead into a fantastic and exciting world, full of brightness and darkness of life.

programme.title: Dead Men Walk
programme.desc: The twin of a kindly small-town physician returns from the grave for vengeance against his brother, who secretly killed him because the twin served Satan.

programme.title: Hantise
programme.desc: After an accident, Agnes wakes up, amnesiac. She is introduced to her husband, her child, her house, her job, her life. Or the one people wants to tell her?

programme.title: Hantise
programme.desc: After an accident, Agnes wakes up, amnesiac. She is introduced to her husband, her child, her house, her job, her life. Or the one people wants to tell her?

programme.title: Mother
programme.desc: A teenaged girl witnesses her widowed mother's attempt to sustain her family.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian is a kindly scientist who seeks to cure a young woman's polio. He needs human spinal fluid to complete the formula for his experimental serum. Meanwhile, a vicious circus ape has broken out of its cage, and is terrorizing the townspeople. Can there be a connection?

programme.title: Omsch
programme.desc: A travelling artist, painter and filmmaker has a centenarian neighbour. The relationship between this man in his forties and the solitary old lady with a wicked sense of humour gradually becomes a kind of elective kinship. Their discussions, interrupted and picked up again over the years, form the fabric of this personal, tender and surprising film.

programme.title: Career Girl
programme.desc: Joan Terry, a girl from the country wants to become a Broadway Star, but this proves to be not so easy.

programme.title: West of the Divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden impersonates a wanted man and joins Gentry's gang only to learn later that Gentry was the one who killed his father. He saves Virginia Winters' dad's ranch from Gentry and also rescues his long-lost brother Spud.

programme.title: The Lady Refuses
programme.desc: A wealthy London nobleman hires a pretty but poor young woman to distract his playboy son from marrying a golddigger. Complications ensue when the girl and the father begin to fall for each other, and things get even more complicated when the son declares his love for her, too.

programme.title: Guerrero
programme.desc: In the depths of the Sierra of Guerrero in Mexico, after the disappearance of the 43 students, we find the reaction of wounded civil society to seek an answer to the situation of abuse of authority mixed with poverty.

programme.title: The Jungle Woman
programme.desc: When a treasure hunter seeks a downed airplane in the jungles of Africa, he encounters one of the passenger's young daughter, now fully grown, and with a gorilla protector.

programme.title: The Captive Heart
programme.desc: A series of stories about the lives and loves of nine men in a Prisoner of War Camp over five years. Location shooting in the British occupied part of Germany adds believability. The main story is of Hasek (Redgrave) a Czech soldier who needs to keep his identity a secret from the Nazis, to do this he poses as a dead English Officer and corresponds with the man's wife. Upon liberation they meet and decide to continue their lives together. The other inmates' stories are revealed episodically.

programme.title: Parlor, Bedroom and Bath
programme.desc: Jeffrey Haywood wants to marry to Virginia Embrey. However, Virginia refused to marry unless her older sister, the hard-to-please Angelica gets married first. Angelica, in turn, finds every man she knows too dull and predictable, and for this reason prefers to stay single. Jeff then tries to make Angelica interested in the mild-mannered and timid Reggie Irving passing him off as a notorious playboy to intrigue her. He asks his friend Polly to teach Reggie "how to treat a woman right", but he turns to be a disastrous learner.

programme.title: The Strange Love of Martha Ivers
programme.desc: Ruthless woman has her dark past of a concealed murder return.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: True smile is the story about a trip through the empty glance of an autist and blind boy who crosses 1.300 kms in tandem bycicle with his brother. This documentary inmerses us into the Sergio's unreachable world, that seems to the desert, the destination of their trip.

programme.title: The Inner Circle
programme.desc: A private detective finds himself with a perfect new secretary. But after a notorious gossip columnist turns up murdered, she may prove too good to be true.

programme.title: Abilene Town
programme.desc: Marshall Dan Mitchell, who is the law in Abilene, has the job of keeping peace between two groups. For a long time, the town had been divided, with the cattlemen and cowboys having one end of town to themselves, while townspeople occupied the other end. Mitchell liked it this way, it made things easier for him, and kept problems from arising between the two factions.

programme.title: Jack London
programme.desc: Episodes in adventurous life of the American novelist.

programme.title: John Wayne Cold Vengeance
programme.desc: John Wayne burns up the screen in this thrilling tale of vengeance in the Wild West. When his father is gunned down by bandits, John Mason (Wayne) hatches a plot to catch the killer. Little does he know the killer has plans of his own! Featuring a thrilling gun battle with famed Wayne collaborator Yakima Canutt, Cold Vengeance has been beautifully restored and is in color for the very first time.

programme.title: A Shriek in the Night
programme.desc: Rival newspaper reporters Pat Morgan and Ted Rand find themselves unraveling the mystery behind the death of a millionaire philanthropist who fell from his penthouse balcony. When it is discovered that the plunge was not an accident, the building's residents come under suspicion. Soon, the body count begins to mount as three more murders occur by strangulation.

programme.title: Sunny
programme.desc: The beautiful Anna Neagle stars as a circus performer who falls in love with a rich car dealer's son, against her family's wishes. Features some spirited dance numbers with Ray Bolger.

programme.title: Hitler: Beast of Berlin
programme.desc: Hans Memling, a young intellectual, patriotic German, is secretly opposed to the Nazi regime. With the aid of Gustav Schultz, Father Pommer, Anna Wahl and others, he is gleaning accurate information from foreign radio broadcasts and distributing it through Germany with an underground-press operation.

programme.title: Dok nas smrt ne rastavi
programme.desc: Ubistvo je, kao i prava ljubav, zapisano u zvezdama. Detektivi, porodica i prijatelji podsećaju se slučajeva veza koje su se završile ubistvom.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Dejvid je u poseti dr Emi zbog velike izrasline na leđima koja naglo raste. A, Arijina promena pola iz muškog u ženski je unazađena jer joj na licu raste brada.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Sari je zbog teške rozacee lice tako crveno da joj je suviše neprijatno da izlazi napolje. I još, dr. Ema koristi naprednu tehnologiju da bi uklonila tumor sa Trejsilininog nosa.

programme.title: Klinika za kožne probleme
programme.desc: Koža na Haninim stopalima je veoma zadebljala i ispucala. Maraja ponovo dolazi kod doktorke Eme, zbog svojih akni, koje joj ostavljaju ožiljke.

programme.title: Venčanica iz snova: Beneluks
programme.desc: Pratite holandske i flamanske neveste u potrazi za savršenom venčanicom. Američki guru za venčanice Rendi Fenoli će im pomoći u u tom procesu.

programme.desc: Ohrabrujuće i inspirativne priče jedinstvenih pojedinaca širom sveta koji žive sa retkim zdravstvenim problemima i koji su rešeni da žive svoje najbolje živote.

programme.title: Klinika za lečenje gojaznosti u Italiji
programme.desc: Visoko specijalizovana klinika u Napulju pomaže morbidno gojaznim ljudima dok pokušavaju da smanje svoju težinu i uđu u najtežu godinu svog života.

programme.desc: Visoko specijalizovana klinika u Napulju pomaže morbidno gojaznim ljudima dok pokušavaju da smanje svoju težinu i uđu u najtežu godinu svog života.

programme.title: Salon za neveste sa oblinama
programme.desc: Rut je bolovala od bulimije, pre nego što je postala model za krupnije dame. Džo i El pomažu Lizi da bude zvezda svog venčanja.

programme.title: Salon za neveste sa oblinama
programme.desc: Nakon što je izgubila supruga, Liza ponovo pronalazi ljubav i želi da pronađe lepu venčanicu. Šanel nikako ne uspeva da pronađe haljinu za venčanje.

programme.title: Salon za neveste sa oblinama

programme.desc: Bonjour! We're headed to Quebec Province on today's show. First, we get blown away by the thunderous pipes at Montreal's Notre Dame Basilica. After that, we go underneath the city at the Pointe a Calliere archaeology museum. Next, we'll learn about the native ecosystem at the gigantic, indoor, BioDome. Lastly, we'll learn about the 1967 Montreal Expo at the structures that are still visited today.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This episode we visit the bright lights of Vancouver, Canada. We'll swing along the famous Capilano Suspension Bridge, get tranquil in Dr. Sun Yat Sen's Chinese garden, learn about Captain Vancouver at the Vancouver Maritime Museum, dig up Cesna Em "The City Before the City" at the Museum of Vancouver, and dive into the city's seedy underbelly at the Police Museum.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Annual brood stock fishery from Percy Walkus Hatchery in Wuikinuxv, Rivers Inlet...conserving the largest Chinook on Earth!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears journeys into the remote wilderness region of Arnhem land to the Cooper Creek Billabong. He's there during the dry season and all the wild life is concentrated into a narrow stretch of water. He comes face to face with the dominant saltwater crocodile and watches as the croc manoeuvres a dead pig down river to a secret hiding place. Ray travels into Stone Country above the Billabong where he finds a gallery of ancient Aboriginal art and joins locals Connie Nayinggul and her grandson Moses on a fishing expedition. They catch a barramundi and cook the fish in a traditional ground oven using paper bark.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Agra is home to India's most recognizable monument—the Taj Mahal. First, we tour the Agra Fort and learn its role in the incredible history behind the Taj Mahal's construction. Bill takes us to a factory where we learn how the craft of stone inlay that adorns the Taj Mahal, is still made today. We continue on to Fatehpur Sikri, a former Mughal capital, which was created of red sandstone and displays the influence of its Hindu and Mughal roots. Finally, we meet with a man that is giving the wildlife of India a voice and sanctuary.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Two of the most sacred places in India are featured in this fascinating episode. Bill first burst the myths surrounding the legendary Khajuraho and its intricately carved temples before heading to the Holy City of Varanasi. Varanasi, the Jerusalem or Mecca for Hindus with its deep connection to the Ganges River, is explored with an insider's perspective.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: One of the Seven Natural Wonders of the World—all other great wilderness areas are compared to this vast savannah. Wildlife numbers are awesome, but nothing like the numbers of the great migration. Journeys places you in the midst of this natural phenomenon where predator and prey are on a march for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: Host Bill Ball begins the ascent of the highest mountain in Africa. Trouble almost immediately affects the team as the cameraman suffers from fatigue and altitude sickness. Just over halfway, the trip is in serious doubt as altitude, cold and wind force the team to evaluate their fitness to continue.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Pro mountain bikers take to the rocky mountain terrain of Mexico's Copper Canyon for the ride of their life.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: X games medalists take to the slopes of Haines, Alaska to experience the ultimate in heli-skiing; a challenge to even the best of the best.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Miracle Venom explores the strange, and often bizarre world of the oceans most venomous animals. Follow Dr. Glen Burns as he handles deadly Sea Snakes with only his bare hands. You'll be amazed at how a small Cone Snail hunts, paralyses and then eats it's prey alive. The waters of Papua New Guinea and Australia's Great Barrier Reef harbour an exceptional variety of venomous fish and invertebrates.The poisons of these animals are some of the most lethal known to man.They also, however, hold enormous potential in the development of therapeutic drugs.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where, in the past few years, diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan joins world-renown cave explorer Brian Kakuk to investigate the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world! The formations in this cave are simply stunning, and incredibly unique.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. But to find out, Jonathan has to brave some very cold water. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Loro Parque, voted "World's Best Zoo" two years in a row, blends top-tier animal care with global conservation efforts. From thousands of species to multi-million-dollar research, its mission is clear: protect wildlife and inspire change. What began 45 years ago as one man's passion is now a global model of excellence in education, sustainability, and animal welfare.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Federica the turtle has arrived from Italy after a run in with a container ship. Loro Parque's offered to be her 'forever home', but how will she go sharing her new digs with others? You've heard of a fish out of water _ try a turtle!Esmeralda the iguana has a lumpy belly and Jorge the vet is worried. He's hoping it's a bounty of eggs but knows he shouldn't count his iguanas before they hatch. Its fingers crossed for some scaly babies!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The explosive sprinting Cheetah. The mighty bounding kangaroo. The horned and leaping wildebeest. The powerful and sure footed horse. Or the quick footed pronghorn. Which is the fastest over land? Cheetah _ On Africa's savannahs, predator and prey race at breathtaking speeds. Pronghorn _ North America's fastest, it sustains 60 km/h and can reach nearly 100. Wildebeest _ Iconic endurance runners; calves walk within minutes and run within days. Kangaroo _ Australia's largest marsupial, alert and powerful, built for speed. Brumby _ Wild horses, symbols of strength and freedom, gallop unbridled across Australia.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: In nature, both males and females fight fiercely—especially females defending their young. Most battles occur within the same species over food, territory, status, or mates. While not always fatal, these fights can lead to death. Animals protect food sources directly or by defending territory rich in prey. This territorial aggression helps distribute populations but can also limit them—like wolves starving without territory. Though fighting can secure survival, it comes at a cost: injury, exhaustion, and death. Often, avoiding conflict is the wisest strategy.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Masters of stealth or speed, using enhanced senses and lethal strategies to hunt, Africa's killers include the incredibly fast cheetah and lions, which while slower, have raw power and ingenious teamwork on their side. The rivers, meanwhile, hold fearsome crocodiles.

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: Across Africa, predators use the land to amplify their hunting skills. In Ndutu, cheetahs rely on speed and lookout points, even using fawns as bait. Lions, heavier and slower, depend on cover—gullies, marshes, forests—for ambushes. As the wildebeest migration arrives, we follow three characters through the rainy season, watching calves grow and predators adapt. The film explores how these hunters use the landscape, passing knowledge from one generation to the next.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: There's more than just one creature lurking in this black lagoon. Here, in this bizarre netherworld between river and ocean, evolution has created a variety of freakish assassins, many of whom can strike in the blink of an eye. Witness the fast-paced, deadly action up close and in slow motion as our high-speed cameras capture sharp-shooting archerfish, African fish eagles, mantis shrimp, and other killers at work. Cutting-edge CGI details show just how they use their alien jaws, spear-like arms, and color-changing skin as weapons of underwater war.

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: Whale Sharks: Gentle Giants introduces us to this amazing creature through scientists who are racing against time to save the species. Utilizing space-age technology from NASA and the Hubble Telescope, researchers are able to identify, catalogue and track individual sharks. In Mexico and remote Western Australia, whale shark tourism has proven to be both a blessing and a curse, as more and more boats vie for fewer animals. The program also features the remarkable story of shark cowboys who captured and transported 4 live whale sharks (in customized jumbo jets) to the Georgia Aquarium in Atlanta.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Rafa, the 'Birdman of Loro Parque', proudly leads the Foundation's ornithological work, surrounded daily by parrots, puffins, and penguins. Meanwhile, Inaki faces a challenge: training Sue-Anne the anteater. Armed with vanilla yoghurt and patience, he's hoping charm wins over stubbornness. Will she cooperate or snub his efforts?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.desc: Team members Patricia Marin and Malinka Franklin help a lost soul cross over into the light.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The former home of Queen Victoria is now home to many spirits who have been seen by guests and staff. Witness the first ever formal documentation of the paranormal activities in the Bulkeley Hotel.

programme.title: What In the World

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: This show features some segments that didn't fit in their respective episodes. We play around at the Pinball Museum in Las Vegas. Then, we salute the Commander in Chief at the Presidential Hall of Fame in Clermont, FL. Also, we'll swim with real mermaids at Weeki Wachee Springs in Central Florida, and cheer on Teddy Ballgame at the Ted Williams Hitters Hall of Fame.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: In this episode we visit the Kennedy Space Center located on Florida's famous "Space Coast." We'll speak to NASA engineers about the past, present and future of American space travel, as well as take a look at the attractions KSC has to offer.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: In the spirit of coastal conservation, Big Coast practices catch-and-release Tyee Chinook Salmon (over 30lbs) angling and only taking what you need. Going strong for 15 years, Big Coast features 13 new half hour episodes every year! A 300-mile boat trip from Vancouver to Duncanby Lodge in Rivers Inlet for Percy Walkus Hatchery Chinook Fundraiser!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In Victoria just south west of Melbourne in the You Yangs National Park Ray Mears meets up with researcher Janine Duffy in a dry eucalyptus forest. They go in search of koalas and find a young male who nervously tries to establish his own territory.Ray moves down to the open grasslands and tracks a mob of Eastern Grey kangaroos. He visits the Mount Rothwell Conservation Reserve and meets an unusual marsupial _ a predator _ that is almost extinct on the mainland of Australia _ a Tiger Quoll _ smaller relative of the Tasmanian Devil. Finally Ray journeys through a Wet Eucalyptus forest to Lake Elizabeth and canoeing across the quiet waters finds himself surrounded by rare and unique duck billed platypuses

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Show Me Where You Live
programme.desc: Show me where you live is a documentary series that aims to answer the following question: How can human beings claim ownership to a space so that they can live safely within it, function as a society, and above all be in harmony with the environment around them? As we discover cultures and emblematic populations, we follow Philippe Simay who is at the heart of Inhabiting the World and represents its identity and originality. Philippe takes us on an epic adventure around the Human Habitat and sets the tone for the journey. As a humanist and philosopher, Philippe is a tireless surveyor of the city, and an explorer of living spaces. Determined to travel around the world, Philippe unveils how the populations that he encounters claim the space they occupy, shapes it and adjust to it.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling's wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks, the inspiration for The Jungle Book and many other tales. There, we track tigers and search for jackal, sambar, chital, monkeys and wild boar. We round out the episode with jeep safaris, elephant rides and dinners around the fire.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Journeys explores the history and fables that surround the controversial rebel leader Tipu Sultan. Mysore was the center of an Empire strong enough to challenge the British. Tipu's over-the-top personality is reflected in the architecture, gardens and stories that still permeate this metropolis.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: The name alone conjures up mysterious and exotic images. The architecture and backstory to this once powerful independent kingdom, is both amazing and horrifying. Outside the city, Zanzibar earns its "Spice Island" nickname due to the huge plantations that grow everything to make your cooking flavorful. Journeys final stop is to visit the highly endangered Red Colobus monkeys. Learn why these human-like primates eat dirt for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In this first of a two-parter on the Mara, we follow the migration in anticipation of the famous river crossings. We find all three big cats and hyena waiting for their chance to get their share of the migrants. During migration, the animal numbers are staggering.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: An international team kayaks the classic runs of New Zealand's south island and in turn they find a new adventure around every bend.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: The biggest stars of snowmobile head to the Rocky Mountains for an epic adventure.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.
